create.name: Dr. Shefali Tsabary
create.bio:
Dr. Shefali Tsabary, known simply as Dr. Shefali, is the founder of the Conscious Parenting approach, which treats raising children as a path of awakening for the parent as much as for the child. Trained as a clinical psychologist at Columbia University, she brings that background together with Eastern contemplative philosophy, and her central idea is that parents change their families most by noticing and outgrowing their own conditioning rather than by controlling their children.

She has written several books on this theme, among them The Conscious Parent, The Awakened Family, A Radical Awakening, aimed at women, and The Parenting Map, plus a recent pair on raising sons and daughters, and she hosts the Parenting & You podcast. Her teaching reaches people through a monthly online membership called the Conscious Circle, self-paced courses on parenting, relationships and self-worth, a five-month institute that certifies conscious parenting and life coaches, a yearly live gathering called EVOLVE, and occasional women's retreats. Her YouTube channel carries long conversations and short daily reflections on presence, solitude and seeing life as it is.

courses.title: The Conscious Circle
courses.description: Her online membership: monthly workshops and live question-and-answer sessions with Dr. Shefali, a library of past teachings and a members' community for parents and seekers.

courses.title: Conscious Coaching Institute (Cohort 15)
courses.description: A five-month online certification for people who want to work as conscious parenting and life coaches, beginning with their own inner work. Applications close on 31 December.

courses.title: EVOLVE 2027
courses.description: Her yearly live weekend in San Francisco, with teaching, reflection and group practice, plus an optional meditation day for four-day and premium ticket holders.

courses.title: A Radical Awakening Retreat, Bali
courses.description: A women's retreat in Bali led by Dr. Shefali, combining her teachings with breathwork, rituals on the beach and time in community.

courses.title: A Radical Awakening 10-Day Deep Dive
courses.description: A self-paced course of about fifteen hours, based on her book for women, on recognising inherited patterns and stepping into a freer sense of self.

courses.title: The Awakened Heart
courses.description: A guided online course that works inward layer by layer towards a sense of inner wholeness.

courses.title: Conscious Parenting 2.0 (Level 1 & Level 2)
courses.description: Her step-by-step parenting method as a recorded course, for parents who want to replace control and reaction with presence and connection.

free_resources.title: Free Courses and Meditations
free_resources.description: A page of free recordings, including a global meditation session and an informal series of meditations she offered to the public.

free_resources.title: Parenting & You with Dr. Shefali (podcast)
free_resources.description: Her podcast of conversations and listener questions on parenting, relationships and personal growth.
